lines.text: Before books — before stone carvings — something was already keeping records.
A pattern that worked — a shape, a colour, a way to hide, a way to hunt — was never written down. It was copied.
Every new generation was a fresh copy of the archive.
But this archive had a fatal weakness: die before you copy yourself, and the information dies with you.
The planet's first archive wasn't built. It was alive.

what_it_is: The delivered programme audio — guide narration over the continuous bed — extracted from the delivered render. The piece speaks the GUIDE voice; there is no clone candidate. The delivered mix measures −14.72 LUFS / TP −1.20 (render/verification.json; the upload package's QC notes the guide voice needed a compression + limiter chain to reach spec, and logs upstream gain-staging as pipeline debt — a build note, carried here as the audio layer's own record of its mastering). Bed continuity measured at this migration: ffmpeg silencedetect (−45 dB, minimum duration 0.5 s) over the delivered mix returns no silence event between the content start and the content end (28.776 s) — the only events are the opening (0 → 2.21 s, before the first line at 2.550 s) and the end hold (28.79 s → 32.28 s); the bed plays through, and the piece's pauses are narration events, not mix gaps. The delivered audio is MONO (AAC, 1 channel) — measured at this migration; see render/verification.json tensions for its standing against the P-04 stereo standard.
